title: Prepare the fixed 2026-08-09 Grade-R card directly from TARGET DR/DU and audited JRA history

proposal_scope.title: Prepare the fixed 2026-08-09 Grade-R card directly from TARGET DR/DU and audited JRA history
proposal_scope.hypothesis: A deterministic adapter over the already-fixed TARGET DR/DU card and JRA-VAN SU/SR history can reproduce the existing 24 previous-race inputs and run the unchanged frozen EXP023 model, candidate policy, C0 calibrator, confidence threshold, and tie-break for all 36 races without waiting for a 17 MB TARGET HTML export.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: Direct TARGET history cannot reproduce the HTM-derived input contract and today's candidate decisions within the pre-registered parity gates, a latest prior race cannot be proven, or any model, policy, threshold, market, BUY, order, dashboard, or notification change is required.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The prediction logic is unchanged; only the source adapter for the same prior-race variables changes. TARGET DR/DU fixes tomorrow's race and runner universe, while JRA-VAN SU/SR contains pre-race runner and race records needed to reconstruct the existing time, popularity, field, surface, distance, going, final-section, PCI-family, bodyweight, jockey, and track fields.
proposal_scope.target_population: All 36 fixed races and 495 runners on the 2026-08-09 Sapporo, Niigata, and Chukyo cards. Every race remains in the denominator. Chukyo 9R is an unsupported obstacle race and must be deterministic no-bet.
out_of_scope: Any alternative pair, ticket type, race, or stake search after observing a quote
Any dashboard mutation, notification, credential, purchase adapter, TARGET GUI automation, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any historical backtest, outer OOS comparison, ROI calculation, or action-policy optimization
Any model training, refit, feature addition, feature removal, calibrator change, candidate reranking, confidence threshold change, value threshold search, or tie-break change
Any odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, result, or derivative in candidate generation, confidence, ranking, tie-break, or abstention
Any silent fallback from an unprovable local or foreign latest race to an older JRA race
Any support for obstacle prediction or domains outside flat turf and flat dirt
rejection_gate: Any current result, odds, popularity, market, payout, ROI, dashboard, notification, credential, BUY, or order side effect reaches candidate generation
Any direct control field differs beyond its declared TARGET display rounding or marker-normalization contract
Any mapped history row violates the strict target-date cutoff
Any model, feature set, calibrator, candidate policy, confidence threshold, value policy, or tie-break changes
Any of the 24 required previous-race columns is absent
Any probability contract violation is accepted
Any registered target disappears or any obstacle or source-contract-failed race becomes candidate-ready
Any supported flat control race changes candidate pair or primary confidence decision
Any unprovable latest local or foreign race silently falls back to an older JRA race
in_scope: Add one audited TARGET SU/SR-to-existing-24-column adapter with deterministic record offsets, race-time conversion, apprentice symbol mapping, track mapping, Ave-3F, final-3F rank, PCI, PCI3, and RPCI calculations

After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, first compare direct TARGET fields and resulting candidates against the fixed 2026-08-08 HTM control; generate the 2026-08-09 research candidates only if every pre-registered parity and safety gate passes
Create a hash-bound source manifest for every SU/SR file actually read and reject any unlisted or changed source
Create identity-only EXP025 config and three fixed target manifests for the 2026-08-09 DR/DU card while preserving every frozen prediction and safety setting from EXP023

During APPROVED_TO_PREPARE run synthetic fixture tests only, including time conversion, rounded PCI3, odd-distance RPCI, obstacle blanks, apprentice symbols, duplicate identity, future-date, local-history absence, and market-firewall cases
Keep formal_buy false, send_order false, stake zero, dashboard mutation false, notification false, credential access false, and order imports disabled
Normalize TARGET's trailing PCI presentation marker only when converting to the numeric training-time PCI field, retaining the marker as lineage metadata
lineage_hash_requirements: Each experienced runner maps exactly one latest provable prior row strictly before target date; an unprovable latest local or foreign race fails closed rather than selecting an older JRA row
Every Top3-set and derived WIDE distribution passes mass, finite, range, support, and duplicate checks
Every direct field records source file, source record identity, source race date, and canonical record hash
Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero
The frozen model artifact, candidate policy, calibrator, confidence threshold, and tie-break are byte-identical to EXP023
Tomorrow DR and DU, today's HTM/DR/DU control, every SU/SR source read, the three target manifests, fold manifest, inference bundle, feature schema, model artifact, and adapter code remain hash-bound
stop_conditions: Any additional predictive, market, threshold, or production change is required
Any late race would need backfill or a source contract would need weakening
Any result, market, credential, notification, dashboard mutation, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order-capable path is encountered
The direct adapter cannot prove the actual latest prior race for any runner it marks ready
Today's supported control candidate pair or confidence decision parity is below 100 percent

chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed next-day Grade-R research card after synthetic adapter preparation, a separate run approval, and a fixed prior-day parity control; there is no fitting, backtest, ROI, or policy search.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only the newest provable history row with event date strictly before each target date may populate previous-race features.
chronological_fold_design.control_clock: The 2026-08-08 HTM/DR/DU and JRA SU/SR control are read only after APPROVED_TO_RUN and are used only to test adapter field and candidate parity.
chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A target whose original cutoff passes before persistence remains in the denominator as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real HTM, DR, DU, SU, SR, inference, candidate, quote, result, payout, or ROI command may run during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE; synthetic fixtures only.

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No history row dated 2026-08-09 or later may enter tomorrow features, and no row dated 2026-08-08 or later may enter the control features.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may influence candidate selection, confidence, tie-break, or abstention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No missed candidate cutoff may be repaired with later information.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 tomorrow race identities and 495 runners are fixed independently of market and results.

primary_metric.name: target_direct_input_and_candidate_parity_then_terminal_completeness
primary_metric.baseline: EXP023 generated today's fixed card from a TARGET HTM export; tomorrow DR/DU is available but tomorrow HTM is absent.
primary_metric.evaluation: First, the direct adapter must pass all synthetic tests and reproduce the fixed control fields under declared rounding and marker rules. Then control candidate pairs and confidence decisions are compared. Only after those gates pass may the unchanged pipeline produce one terminal research record for each of tomorrow's 36 fixed races.

notes: Tomorrow TARGET direct-entry preparation; frozen EXP023 prediction logic; real control and target execution remain separately approval-gated.
